objective: Certificar Gate 7 de Cavas Corporativas verificando fisicamente en SQL canonico que la navegacion/menu corporativo existe, esta activo, apunta a /cavas-corporativas y reutiliza el modulo CAVA_SOCIOS sin duplicar RBAC. No escribir SQL ni repositorio y no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_canonical_menu
queries.sql: SELECT MenuID, ModuloID, MenuPadreID, Codigo, Nombre, Ruta, Orden, RequierePermiso, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_ModulosMenus WHERE Codigo=N'cava.corporativas' OR Ruta=N'/cavas-corporativas' ORDER BY MenuID

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_menu_module_binding
queries.sql: SELECT sm.ModuloID, sm.Codigo AS ModuloCodigo, sm.Nombre AS ModuloNombre, sm.Activo AS ModuloActivo, mm.MenuID, mm.Codigo AS MenuCodigo, mm.Ruta, mm.RequierePermiso, mm.Activo AS MenuActivo FROM dbo.Sistema_Modulos sm INNER JOIN dbo.Sistema_ModulosMenus mm ON mm.ModuloID=sm.ModuloID WHERE sm.Codigo=N'CAVA_SOCIOS' AND (mm.Codigo=N'cava.corporativas' OR mm.Ruta=N'/cavas-corporativas') ORDER BY mm.MenuID

queries.name: cavas_corporativas_menu_collision_count
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Codigo=N'cava.corporativas' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS code_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Ruta=N'/cavas-corporativas' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS route_count FROM dbo.Sistema_ModulosMenus

constraints: Expected canonical row: Codigo=cava.corporativas, Ruta=/cavas-corporativas, RequierePermiso=cava_socios, Activo=1
Expected no collision: code_count=1 and route_count=1
